explanation: States that every member of A063880 (n > 0 with σ(n) = 2·usigma(n)) satisfies n ≡ 108 (mod 216). This matches Ralf Stephan's 2003 observation in OEIS ("Numbers so far are all == 108 (mod 216)", checked to 10^7). The definitions of usigma (sum of divisors d with gcd(d, n/d) = 1) and of membership are correct. Tagging it open is reasonable: it would follow from 108 being the only primitive term, which is itself open.
